entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • RequireHost with wildcard matches "empty" subdomain #66581
  • How to server blazor.web.js when the build version and runtime version don't match #66580

Closed

  • QuickGrid Column Headers don't print on pages 2+ if sortable #66301
    Backlog
  • Single QuickGrid Does Not Support Multiple Paginators #57289
    Backlog

    11.0-preview5

    area-networking
